name: Daniel Hayes
bio:
Daniel's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by countless hours spent tinkering with go-karts and attending local races. He pursued a degree in Electrical Engineering, always with the goal of applying his knowledge to the high-stakes world of racing. After graduating, Daniel cut his teeth at a smaller racing outfit, learning the ropes of data acquisition and electronic systems management. He's now eager to leverage his experience and contribute to Caterham Academy's success.

Daniel approaches his role with meticulous precision and a relentless drive for optimization. He's not afraid to challenge established norms and constantly seeks innovative solutions to improve performance. He believes that a strong understanding of the underlying technology is crucial for unlocking a car's full potential, and is always looking for ways to extract that last tenth of a second. His ability to see the 'big picture' and connect the dots between different electronic systems sets him apart.

While his technical skills are undeniable, Daniel is also a strong believer in teamwork and communication. He understands that success in motorsport requires a collaborative effort, and he strives to build strong relationships with drivers and other engineers. His demanding nature pushes those around him to perform at their best.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Daniel is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even when not working on the car.
Obsessively organizes his workspace, often rearranging equipment for optimal workflow.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
